cmd:
cd /opt/trading-bot/classic
TOK=$(grep GITHUB_TOKEN /etc/vps-github-bridge/token | cut -d= -f2)
cp classic_panel.py backup_both_panel_fix.py
curl -sf -H "Authorization: token $TOK" -H "Accept: application/vnd.github.raw" "https://api.github.com/repos/ruslan591/weather-_Odessa/contents/bot/classic/classic_panel.py" -o /tmp/new_panel.py
python3 -c "import ast;ast.parse(open('/tmp/new_panel.py',encoding='utf-8').read())" && cp /tmp/new_panel.py classic_panel.py && chown tbot:tbot classic_panel.py
systemctl restart classicbot; sleep 8; systemctl is-active classicbot
cd /opt/trading-bot/classic
sudo -u tbot /opt/trading-bot/venv/bin/python - <<'P' 2>&1 | tail -40
import asyncio, time, json
import classic_panel as cp, classic_strategy as cs, classic_hand as hand
runs=json.load(open('runs.json'))
now=int(time.time()*1000)
async def go():
    import aiohttp
    cp.SES=aiohttp.ClientSession()
    for rid in (18,5):
        r=[x for x in runs if x['id']==rid][0]
        df=await cp.get_df_long(r['sym'],r['cfg']['tf'])
        for fwd in (True,False):
            P=dict(cs.PARAMS,**dict(r['cfg'],sym=r['sym'])); P['sim_from_ms']=0; P['hand_forward']=fwd
            tr=cs.pack(cs.simulate(df,now,P))
            print(rid,r['sym'],r['cfg']['tf'],'forward',fwd,'trades',len(tr),[(t.get('sig'),t['side'],t['p_in'],t.get('tp'),t['reason'],t['net']) for t in tr][:6])
asyncio.run(go())
print([ (x['id'],x['sym'],x['tf'],x['kind'],x.get('deleted')) for x in hand.load() if not x.get('deleted')])
P
